tests.name: Accuracy (Weighing) Test
tests.purpose: Determine indication error at test loads across the weighing range and compare against the maximum permissible error (MPE).
tests.requiredObservations: Test load, observed indication at 5 points (Min, 25%, 50%, 75%, Max capacity)
tests.requiredEquipment: Certified test weights / substitution weights, calibrated reference

tests.name: Repeatability Test
tests.purpose: Verify consistency of indication under repeated application of the same load.
tests.requiredObservations: 5 consecutive readings at a fixed test load (~50% capacity)
tests.requiredEquipment: Certified test weight matching selected load
tests.envRequirements: Stable ambient conditions during full test sequence

tests.name: Discrimination Test
tests.purpose: Confirm the instrument responds to a small additional mass at high load.
tests.requiredObservations: Indication before and after adding 1e at/near maximum capacity
tests.requiredEquipment: Small calibrated increment mass (1e)

tests.name: Eccentricity (Corner Load) Test
tests.purpose: Verify indication error remains within tolerance when the load is applied off-center on the load-receptor.
tests.requiredObservations: Indication at center and at 4 corner positions with a fixed load
tests.requiredEquipment: Certified test weight, corner-loading template

tests.name: Sensitivity Test
tests.purpose: Confirm the instrument produces a perceptible, correctly-signed change in indication for the smallest applied increment, at a load chosen by the technician (not only near Max).
tests.requiredObservations: Indication before and after adding a 1e increment mass at the selected load
tests.requiredEquipment: Small calibrated increment mass (1e)

tests.name: Zero-Return Test
tests.purpose: Verify the indication returns to zero, within tolerance, after a load equal to Max capacity is applied and fully removed.
tests.requiredObservations: Indication after removing a full Max-capacity load
tests.requiredEquipment: Certified test weight(s) totalling Max capacity

tests.name: Creep Test
tests.purpose: Verify indication does not drift beyond tolerance while Max capacity remains applied over a sustained period (typically 30 minutes).
tests.requiredObservations: Indication immediately after applying Max load, and again after 30 minutes under that same load
tests.requiredEquipment: Certified test weight(s) totalling Max capacity, stopwatch/timer
tests.envRequirements: Stable ambient conditions for the full duration

tests.name: Tare Performance Test
tests.purpose: Verify indication error remains within the applicable MPE when the tare function is used to zero out a container before weighing a net load.
tests.requiredObservations: Net indication with tare set, against the certified net test load
tests.requiredEquipment: Tare vessel/container, certified test weight for the net load

tests.name: Temperature Effect Test
tests.purpose: Verify indication under a fixed load does not drift beyond the applicable tolerance across a stated change in ambient temperature.
tests.requiredObservations: Indication at a reference temperature and again after a recorded temperature change, same fixed load
tests.requiredEquipment: Certified test weight, calibrated thermometer / environmental chamber
tests.envRequirements: Ambient temperature recorded at both readings

tests.name: Warm-Up Test
tests.purpose: Verify the instrument's indication stabilizes within its stated warm-up time before testing begins.
tests.requiredObservations: Successive zero/no-load readings taken at intervals after power-on until stable
tests.requiredEquipment: Stopwatch/timer
tests.envRequirements: Instrument powered on from cold/off state

tests.name: Voltage Variation Test
tests.purpose: Verify indication under a fixed load does not drift beyond the applicable tolerance across the rated supply-voltage range (electronic instruments only).
tests.requiredObservations: Indication at nominal supply voltage and again at a rated voltage extreme, same fixed load
tests.requiredEquipment: Certified test weight, variable-voltage supply

tests.name: Span Stability Test
tests.purpose: Verify the instrument's span (full-scale calibration) remains within tolerance between two calibration checks separated in time.
tests.requiredObservations: Indication at Max load on two separate span-check occasions
tests.requiredEquipment: Certified test weight(s) totalling Max capacity

ruleVersions.notes: Per-class MPE breakpoints per R 76-1 Table 6 (I: 50 000e/200 000e; II: 5 000e/20 000e; III: 500e/2 000e; IIII: 50e/200e), coarse-e n-range/Min limits per Table 3 (Class II e>=0.1 g, Class III e>=5 g), initial and in-service (2x) stages. Supersedes v2.0, which applied the Class III breakpoints to every class.

Superseded 2026-09-28 by v2.1. Defect: one 500e/2 000e MPE table was used for all classes (correct only for Class III). Results for Class III are unaffected; Class I, II and IIII results issued under v2.0 must be re-evaluated.
Historical configuration retained for traceability. Superseded by v2.0 on 2026-01-01.
